comment: Read from the maker's source at tag commit 7a96486 (v2.1.0), the installed version. The gain attenuverter multiplies the gain input without the divide by ten the feedback, shape and mix attenuverters use, so 10V at that jack with the attenuverter fully clockwise adds 10 to a gain knob whose own range is 0 to 10. The fold knob is the one parameter with randomizeEnabled set false. Panel order and index order differ among the large knobs: index 2 is the shape knob and index 3 the mix knob, while index 4 is the fold knob drawn between the gain and feedback row and the shape and mix row.
